notes.text: Shabbat 110b follows קי:. under the colon convention, with terminal stop; no named edition is independently checked.
Both the heading and body have מהבאי, conventionally Mahavai; they do not differ from one another. Earlier machine OCR had מחבאי. The parenthetical Tanna is preserved without adding a personal title.
